metadata.title: A Global 1% Company: Fuyao Glass — Yongqing with Auto Veteran Yan
metadata.guest_role: Auto product manager, ~7 years; 5 years at Hesai lidar

conclusion: Yongqing calls Fuyao a global 1% name: ~40% gross for 20 years, ~20%+ net, ~4% dividend, while auto-parts books blew up in China's price war. Yan (seven years auto, five at Hesai) watched lidar GM go 70–80% then 40%, CATL 40% to the low 20s — Fuyao did not. China share >70%; last year ~40 million vehicles, ~40% global; a 20–25% capacity add aims at 50 million. ROE >20% for two decades. Ford is the US OEM book; Tesla is the EV glass ask. The stock has been the weak tape next to the P&L.
background: E204, Sept 18. Yan: seven years auto product, five at Hesai lidar. He used Fuyao as a capital-allocation case in a Beida / Gui Jiang class — cycle timing, management, and a 20-year 40% gross that lidar and CATL did not keep. Yongqing calls it a global 1% name whose chart lagged the book in the parts war, and will do CATL later. Whisper turns 福耀/禾赛 into 抚药/河赛; quotes below are the audible strings.
important_facts: Share and scale: China >70%. Official last-year attach ~40 million cars; Yan reads that as ~40% of global builds after a few years at 35% of revenue overseas. US about a third, Europe ~20%. Group is adding 20–25% capacity toward 50 million vehicles — half a year of world production. That is the giant print. ROE stuck above 20% for 20-plus years. Revenue CAGR >10%, profit CAGR a point higher. 4% dividend plus a capex wave is the 'is there a ticket' question while the chart lagged the book in a parts recession.

Margins versus peers: Fuyao ~40% gross for 20 years and ~20%+ net. Hesai opened 70–80% then sat at 40% for years. CATL opened mid-40s and slid to the 20s. Yan's first puzzle: a pane of glass holding 'tech' margins. Second: can you still buy the compounder. Third: the company is a teaching file — cycle timing, capital, and a management that did not follow every peer into a volume-for-share death.

Industry: auto glass is not a commodity if you already tool the world's platforms. Ford-class US volume and Tesla-class EV glass (HUD, roof, weight) sit on the same line. Domestic EV price war smashed many parts P&Ls; Fuyao's print did not. Diligence the 20–25% capacity add: it is either the 50-million share grab or a cycle miss. Do not mark 3606.HK on last year's weak tape against a 20-year 40% gross. HUD glass is the mix upgrade on the tape: BMW work from 2015, now on cars in the low-¥100,000s, and a ~¥500-class HUD stack versus plain glass. Tesla is already on that line. Yan's Ford mailbox case is the US OEM book, not a glass multiple. The 4% dividend plus the 20–25% add is the ticket question while the chart lagged the 20-year file in a parts recession.

mental_model.name: Platform Glass × 20-Year 40% × Capacity Add
mental_model.components: Own China at >70% and attach 40 million cars. Keep 40% gross while lidar and cells compressed. Add 20–25% capacity toward 50 million. ROE >20%, ~10%+ growth, 4% dividend. The chart can lag the book in a parts war. Yan's Hesai years are the control: lidar opened at 70–80% gross and sat at 40%; CATL opened mid-40s and slid to the 20s. Fuyao kept ~40% gross and ~20%+ net while China EV parts books broke. The 20–25% capacity add toward 50 million cars is the only growth ask that can break the 20-year file — either it buys half the world's glass or it is a cycle miss. Ford mailboxes and Tesla HUD/roof glass sit on the same platform line. A 4% dividend in a weak tape is how Yongqing frames the ticket, not a one-year price-war print.
mental_model.application: 3606.HK is the 1% file. F is the US OEM book. TSLA is EV glass, not a multiple on Fuyao. Diligence the capacity add, not a one-year price-war print.

key_insights.view: 40% gross for 20 years is the oddity.
key_insights.question: What did Yan see at Hesai?
key_insights.answer: Lidar 70–80% then 40%. CATL 40s to 20s. Fuyao did not slide. Net still 20%+.

key_insights.question: How global is it?
key_insights.answer: China >70%, US ~1/3, Europe ~20%. A 20–25% add aims at half the world's builds.

key_insights.question: Is there a ticket?
key_insights.answer: 4% dividend plus capex in a parts recession. Do not mark the 20-year book on a weak year.

top_investment_implications.thesis: 20-year 40% GM, >70% China, 40M cars toward 50M — the weak tape is the ask — medium
EV glass/HUD/roof sit on Fuyao's line, not a glass multiple — low
